items.stem: In a food chain, which organism is the producer?

options.text: A grass plant that makes its own food by photosynthesis
options.rationale: Correct: producers make their own food and begin the chain.
A fox is a consumer, not a producer.

options.text: A mushroom breaking down dead leaves

options.rationale: A rabbit is a primary consumer.

items.stem: Why are there usually fewer top predators than plants in an ecosystem? (Select ONE)

options.text: Energy is lost at each step, so less is available higher up the chain
options.rationale: Correct: energy transfer is inefficient, limiting higher levels.

options.text: Predators choose to live alone for no reason
options.rationale: It is energy availability, not preference.

options.text: Energy increases at each step up the chain
options.rationale: Energy decreases, not increases, up the chain.
